title: Why Aren't There Enough Toy Fixers?
story: There aren't enough people to fix toy bricks and video games, even though the pay is good. Kids love these toys, but not enough people are learning to fix them.
storyBig: There's a labor shortage in the toy repair industry, particularly affecting toy bricks and video game maintenance. Despite competitive wages, the industry struggles to attract skilled workers.
think: Why do you think some jobs are harder to fill than others?
bull: Lots of jobs are available for toy fixers, which means a great opportunity to learn and earn!
bear: Without enough fixers, toy repairs could take longer, leaving toys broken for a while.

rss: My self-care ritual is a meal at a fancy restaurant - on my own
title: Eating Pizza Alone is Cool Now!
story: More kids are eating pizza by themselves, and they love it! This trend is making pizza restaurants very happy.
storyBig: Solo dining has become a popular trend, particularly among younger consumers, positively impacting pizza restaurant sales as more customers choose to enjoy meals alone.
think: Why do you think some people enjoy eating alone?
bull: Eating alone can be fun because you get to choose everything you want!
bear: If everyone eats alone, family and friends might miss spending time together over meals.
